tags.definition: Total elapsed estimate is at most 15 minutes; an inclusive ceiling.
Total elapsed estimate is at most 30 minutes; an inclusive ceiling, not exactly 30.
The authored qualitative cost tier is very_low or low; this is not a live price guarantee.
Authored culinary style: warm, rich-tasting or familiar rather than a measured nutrition property.
Authored as a sweet dessert; may also be used as a snack.
Base flavours are mild to moderate; optional chilli is served separately. Not advice for infants, toddlers or individual allergies.
At least the specifically identified component can be frozen; inspect freezerScope and freezerNotes before freezing an assembled dish.
Estimated base fibre supplies at least 3 g per 100 kcal; provisional internal tag. No cooked-weight claim is made.
Estimated base protein supplies at least 20% of estimated base energy; provisional internal tag, not a verified commercial claim.
A useful cooked or prepared component can be made ahead using the specified fridge/freezer and assembly instructions; not a seven-day fridge guarantee.
Main cooked component uses one pan; a toaster, kettle or cold serving bowl may still be needed.
Main cooked component uses one pot; cold toppings or bread may be handled separately.
Total elapsed estimate, including mandatory rest or chilling, is at most 30 minutes.
Authored as a snack, including savoury snacks.
Main components roast together on a tray; cold sauce or a separately cooked side may be needed.
No intentional animal-derived base ingredients. Brand labels and any changes still require checking.
No intentional meat or fish ingredients in the base; suitable cheese rennet and product labels remain mandatory.

costLevels.very_low: Mostly economical grains, eggs, legumes or dairy with modest extras; no current DKK threshold.
costLevels.low: Everyday ingredients intended to be economical; store, pack size, season and offers may change the ranking.
costLevels.medium: A larger meat, fish, cheese or nut component, still designed for normal supermarket shopping.
costLevels.high: A small minority with comparatively expensive protein or other ingredients. Not a live price estimate.

prohibitedInferences: Do not treat quick as active hands-on time only.
Do not treat budget as a quoted meal price.
Do not infer allergy safety from vegetarian or vegan.
Do not reuse tags after changing ingredients without re-evaluating them.
No low-calorie tag is used because a meal-size target does not establish a regulated low-energy claim.
